title: oncocarpus macrophylla
intro: Oncocarpus macrophylla, commonly known as the 'large-leaved Oncocarpus', is a plant species native to tropical regions. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, supporting overall well-being and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Oncocarpus macrophylla include its ability to modulate blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
